name: @auto-pigeon/offline-workspace-contract
description: The cross-stack contract for Offline Shared Workspaces: versioned entity schemas, the Offline role -> capability table, the stable refusal-code vocabulary, the state machines with their guards, idempotency identities and timestamps, and the product's fixed numbers. Contract data plus a dependency-free reference implementation — no persistence, no endpoints, no UI, no running service.
